question: Six friends, A, B, C, D, E and F, are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. A is to the immediate left of E. B is to the immediate right of F. D is second to the left of F. A and C have equal number of persons between them from both the ends. Who is sitting between A and F?
solution:
From the information given:

Step 1: A and C have an equal numbers of persons between them from both the ends. A is to the immediate left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/275c1b970d9ed775ef01141c9c7ba03ef4f3223f85c7b0e7f8714e975ecf99b8.png] 

Since there are only 6 people A & C will have 2 people between them from either side.
